The leaker who previously found iPhone Duo features in Apple's code has now done the same for HomePad. The setup process for the upcoming device shares a common feature with Apple's foldable iPhone.

The leaker points out that the setup process will take place within the Home app, and shared three screenshots of the setup process……

iPhone Duo StandBy Mode

Apple's StandBy mode offers several options that can turn your iPhone into a useful information display while charging. Leaker pdfu previously shared five unreleased StandBy screens for iPhone Duo found in the Xcode simulator.

  • Home Camera
  • Home Modular
  • Flow
  • Fade
  • Snoopy

HomePad Setup Screens

One of the StandBy screen options is Photo Face, and pdfu says HomePad will also offer this option.

He explains that the setup process will have the device download a few high-resolution photos first for immediate selection while your full photo library downloads from iCloud.

We expect Apple's smart home hub to launch on October 13, with a design based on the iMac G4. You can read more about the reportedly design details here.
